★ Keep a list per character: pick a list above, then tap ☆ on a spell to add it. Lists are saved in this browser only, so clearing site data or switching devices starts fresh (💾 back up everything to keep them). To move or share one, use 🔗 Copy Link: the link holds the list's name and spells, and whoever opens it can save a copy.

How to use the Spellbook

The 319 spells of the SRD 5.1, cantrips through 9th level. Search by name or by what a spell does, then filter by level, school, class, concentration, and ritual. Each card gives the casting time, range, components, duration, and the spell's full text. Tap ☆ to add a spell to a spell list: keep one list per character, and print a list as cards to cut out.

At the table

  • Level-up night: filter by class and level to see what the wizard can learn this time.
  • Mid-fight, someone casts hold person. Search it, check the save, and see whether it needs concentration.
  • Build the cleric's prepared spells as a list, print the cards, and stop passing the rulebook around the table.
  • Send players their spell lists with 🔗 Copy Link. They can save a copy on their own phone.

Works with

Spellcasters rolled in the NPC Generator come with their spells, and the spells in stat blocks there and in the Encounter Builder open from this same list. Monsters that cast them are in the Bestiary.
